Requirement from Manabot (MTG-329), in Jack Heart's words, 2026-11-14: "We should definitely be able to run evals against checkpoints from other experiments. There should be no access boundaries at all on that point."

Observed at 9e8fec1: `etude.jobs.checkpoint_inputs` raises `EtudeError("checkpoint_not_stored")` for a seated checkpoint that no training run of the experiment stored ("such as one by an outside address"), because it resolves only through this experiment's `ExperimentState.checkpoint(key)`.

Wanted: an `EvalJob` (benchmark `checkpoints=` and round-robin `enter=`) can seat any stored checkpoint by its address, whatever experiment trained it, under `etude eval`, `launch` and `queue`; and an experiment file may declare only `eval_jobs` with no `training_jobs`. Use case being built now: Manabot eval-only experiment files that play an LLM (Claude through an API, Qwen on a served model) against the final checkpoint of an earlier experiment. A fuller list of gaps found while writing those files will follow.
